newsitem.title: CHINA: China Erdos Cashmere to expand output.
newsitem.headline: China Erdos Cashmere to expand output.

text.p: China's Inner Mongolia Erdos Cashmere Products Co Ltd plans to produce 5.0 million cashmere sweaters a year by the end of the century, the China News Service said on Tuesday.

Erdos, the world's largest producer of cashmere, could currently produce 2.5 million cashmere sweaters a year, along with 300,000 metres of cashmere cloth and 600,000 cashmere scarfs, the agency said.

The company, located in the northern region of Inner Mongolia, controlled half of China's domestic cashmere market and about one fifth of the international market in 1996, it said but gave no further details.
